title: v6 acceptable interpretations
description: The readings this conversation supports — one, two or three. Not a fixed three: padding the list to reach a quota invents readings the transcript does not carry, and a model that responds naturally is then marked down for failing to address one. `supported_by` names the words that carry each reading, so a reading with nothing to point at is visible. A model under test answers in its own words and passes if it matches any, so this set is the boundary of understanding; `shared_implication` is the line a wrong answer crosses.

supported_by.description: the words in the transcript that carry this reading
